A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TLoRA research. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A–D are readable and support comparison, including matching relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: v1 reports original weight-approximation simulations and subject-driven and controllable generation experiments, including Figures 2–4, Table 1, and appendix results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and additionally reports measured training throughput in Appendix C.2 and Table 5.

M1.justification: The transform-plus-residual procedure, TRM/TR parameterizations, regularizers, and initialization strategy are retained. Correcting the subsection headings to 'tensor-ring' and the residual-core reference from A1:D to C1:D aligns the description with definitions already present in v1.

E1.justification: Both versions use DreamBooth, CelebA-HQ, and ADE20K for the same generation tasks. The SDXL/SDXL-Inpaint and Llama2/Llama2-chat weight-approximation studies are also retained. The added timing evaluation introduces no new dataset or task scenario.

E2.justification: The original generation and approximation comparisons retain their comparator sets, including LoRA, DoRA, OFT, BOFT, ETHER+, and LoRETTA. The new timing table measures existing comparison methods; newly cited methods are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Appendix C.2 introduces a training-throughput evaluation in iterations per second on an NVIDIA A100 for controllable generation. Existing generation and approximation protocols, including splits, training budgets, and hyperparameter tables, remain unchanged; the expanded hardware statement does not establish reruns.

E4.justification: The approximation studies, tensor-shape comparisons, and LoRETTA failure case study are retained. The LoRETTA illustration moves from Figure 11 to Figure 8. The added throughput table provides another benchmark metric without adding an ablation, sensitivity, robustness, or error analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions retain six generated images per controllable-generation test input, mean and standard-deviation reporting, and shared seeds for qualitative comparisons. The timing addition supplies no new repeated-run information, uncertainty estimates, or significance tests.

E6.justification: New Table 5 reports 0.37 and 0.34 iterations/second for TLoRA*(2,4) and TLoRA(2,8), versus LoRA 0.58, DoRA 0.55, ETHER+ 0.30, BOFT 0.35, and OFT 0.34. Existing generation scores, including v1 Table 1 becoming v2 Table 2, are unchanged.

T1.justification: The tensor-ring definitions, identity-initialization and TRM-product propositions, regularization derivations, and Appendix B proofs are retained. The terminology and core-symbol corrections introduce no substantive theoretical result or revised reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contribution: combining learnable dense transforms with compact residual adaptations to improve parameter-efficient text-to-image fine-tuning. The new timing evidence does not redefine these central claims.

C2.justification: Appendix C.2 newly attributes the principal computational overhead to multiplying pretrained weights by transform matrices and interprets the timings as competitive with related transform methods. Existing interpretations of generation results, tensorization benefits, and LoRETTA failures remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 adds a TLoRA code-access link in Section 4 and Appendix C. It expands the hardware disclosure from an 80GB H100 to an 80GB H100 or A100, specifying A100 for the timing measurements. Existing hyperparameters and data-processing instructions are retained.

R1.justification: Eight works are added, covering Sparse High Rank Adapters, PaRA, SaRA, HiRA, BAdam, LISA, GaLore, and Time-Varying LoRA. Appendix D adds discussion of time-varying adapters and distinguishes memory-efficient full-parameter optimizers from pluggable adapters, while retaining the central research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 corrects the tensor-ring subsection headings and an initialization symbol, introduces the T2I abbreviation earlier, adds acknowledgements and short explanatory passages, and reorganizes Appendix C. Most prose and the overall narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: Figures 2–4 receive distinct marker and line styles, and Table 5 is added. The parameter-count table moves and Tables 1–2 exchange numbering. The retained LoRETTA visualization becomes Figure 8, while the supplementary qualitative figures become Figures 9–11.

improvement.justification: The new timing comparison makes computational tradeoffs clearer: TLoRA has throughput similar to OFT/BOFT but lower than LoRA/DoRA. A code-access link, corrected terminology, and clearer plot markers also improve usability. These are limited gains; timing details remain sparse, and the core method, theory, and generation evidence are unchanged.
